title: Dr. Zhang receives 2026 AIChE Forest Products & Biorefining Young Professional Award
body: We are proud to announce that Dr. Xuefeng Zhang has been selected as the recipient of the 2026 AIChE Forest Products & Biorefining Division Young Professional Award. Congratulations!

title: New paper published on multivalent metal-ion hydrophobization of cellulose
body: Our work on the MIM platform using Zr⁴⁺, Fe³⁺, and Al³⁺ to drive hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic transitions in cellulosic materials has been accepted for publication.

title: Lab presents at ACS Spring 2025
body: Dr. Zhang presented our research on engineering the cellulose-water interface, integrating the MIM hydrophobization platform and K-mixer CNF processing work.

title: PhD positions available
body: Two PhD Research Assistantship openings are available in sustainable materials research. Interested candidates please contact Dr. Zhang at xuefeng.zhang1@maine.edu.

title: Sesadhi Presented Wood Veneer Forming Research at UMaine Student Symposium and Won Best Poster Award
body: Sesadhi presented his wood veneer forming research at the UMaine Student Symposium and won the best poster award.
